name: cutpro
description: Generate AI images and videos with any top model (Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, Nano Banana, GPT Image), create realistic AI personas and put them in any video, turn long videos and live streams into short clips, schedule posts to every connected social account, and transcribe audio and video.

interface.longDescription:
Generate images and videos with the best AI models in one place: Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, Nano Banana, GPT Image and more. Describe what you want, pick a model or let CutPro choose the best one for the price, and get the result right in ChatGPT. Animate any image you just made into a video, go from a first to a last frame, or borrow a person, product or style from your references.

Create AI personas: realistic people that stay the same in every photo and video, made from traits or from ready-made characters. Put a persona into any video in place of the person in it, while the scene, camera, motion and sound stay as they were. Perfect for UGC, ads and faceless channels.

CutPro also finds the best moments of a long video and turns them into short, captioned vertical clips. Paste a YouTube, Twitch, Kick or TikTok link and CutPro clips it, ranks the clips, applies your templates, renders the MP4s and posts them to the accounts you connected on cut.pro, now or on a schedule. It clips live streams while they air.

Schedule posts to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, Pinterest and Bluesky: any clip, generated video or persona video can go out now or at the time you choose, and you can move or cancel it before it goes out. Missing an account? ChatGPT hands you the link to connect it on cut.pro and carries on. And CutPro transcribes any audio or video into timed captions, as SRT, VTT, text or JSON, ready to summarize or translate.

ChatGPT always tells you the price and asks before generating, starting a job or publishing anything. Everything happens in your own CutPro workspace, the same one you use on cut.pro.
capabilities: Generate images with any top AI model
Generate and animate videos with Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan and more
Create realistic AI personas and put them in any video
Clip long videos and live streams into short vertical clips
Post and schedule to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and more
Transcribe audio and video into captions
defaultPrompt: Make a 9:16 video of a barista pouring latte art with Veo
Create an AI persona for my product ads
Turn this YouTube video into short clips

positive.description: List the image and video models with their prices
positive.prompt: Which AI models can I make videos with, and how much does each one cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_generation_models and answers with the video models, their durations and their price in credits. Nothing is generated.

positive.description: Generate a video after the user confirms the price
positive.prompt: Make a 5 second vertical video of a cat surfing a wave, with the balanced option. Yes, go ahead with that price.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the balanced video preset and its price with list_generation_models, states the total, starts the video with create_generation once the user agrees, and polls get_generation until it is ready, then shows output.url.

positive.description: Create an AI persona from a description
positive.prompt: Create an AI persona: a woman in her twenties with curly brown hair and a casual style. Yes, you can spend the credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the traits and price with get_persona_catalog, creates the persona with create_persona after the user agrees, and polls get_persona until its photo is ready.

positive.description: Schedule a post of a ready video
positive.prompt: Schedule my latest rendered clip on my TikTok for tomorrow at 6 pm São Paulo time, caption 'new episode'. Yes, publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the clip's edit_id with list_renders, the TikTok account with list_connections, confirms caption, account and time, then creates the post with scheduled_at set to that time in UTC.

positive.description: Transcribe a video in the library
positive.prompt: Transcribe my most recent video and give me an SRT file.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a transcription of the latest library video, polls get_transcription until it is ready and returns the SRT link from download_transcription.

positive.description: Preview a public video before clipping it
positive.prompt: What is this video about and how long is it? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iG9CE55wbtY
positive.expected_behavior: Calls analyze_video once and answers with the video's title and duration. No clipping job starts.

positive.description: Clip a video after the user confirms
positive.prompt: Clip https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iG9CE55wbtY into shorts. Yes, go ahead.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews the video with analyze_video, starts the job with create_submission once the user agrees, then reports the submission status from get_submission.

positive.description: Render a clip and hand back a download link
positive.prompt: Render the best clip of my most recent video and give me the link to download it.
positive.tools_triggered: list_videos, list_submissions, list_clips, render_clip, get_render, download_render
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the top-rated clip with render_clip, checks get_render until it is completed, and returns the signed download URL from download_render.

negative.description: Writing a script needs no CutPro tool
negative.prompt: Write a script for a two-minute YouTube video about making pizza at home.
What will the weather be like in São Paulo tomorrow?

negative.description: Math homework is not something CutPro does

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It runs jobs in the user's existing CutPro workspace; nothing is bought or sold inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Generate images and videos with any top AI model (Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, Nano Banana, GPT Image and more), animate images into videos, and create realistic AI personas that can be put into any video. Generated and persona videos can be posted or scheduled directly, and ChatGPT links you to connect a missing social account. Clipping, live monitoring and transcription work as before.

pt-BR.subtitle: Imagem, vídeo e cortes com IA
pt-BR.description:
Gere imagens e vídeos com os melhores modelos de IA num lugar só: Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, Nano Banana, GPT Image e mais. Descreva o que você quer, escolha o modelo ou deixe o CutPro escolher o melhor pelo preço, e receba o resultado no próprio ChatGPT. Anime uma imagem que você acabou de gerar, vá de um primeiro a um último quadro, ou use uma pessoa, um produto ou um estilo das suas referências.

Crie personas com IA: pessoas realistas que continuam iguais em toda foto e todo vídeo, feitas a partir de características ou de personagens prontos. Coloque uma persona em qualquer vídeo no lugar da pessoa que aparece nele, mantendo cena, câmera, movimento e som. Ideal para UGC, anúncios e canais sem rosto.

O CutPro também encontra os melhores momentos de um vídeo longo e transforma em cortes verticais curtos, com legenda. Cole um link do YouTube, Twitch, Kick ou TikTok e o CutPro clipa, ordena os cortes, aplica seus templates, renderiza os MP4 e publica nas contas que você conectou no cut.pro, na hora ou agendado. Ele clipa lives enquanto estão no ar.

Agende posts no TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, Pinterest e Bluesky: qualquer corte, vídeo gerado ou vídeo de persona sai na hora ou no horário que você escolher, e dá para mudar ou cancelar antes de sair. Falta uma conta? O ChatGPT te passa o link para conectar no cut.pro e continua de onde parou. E o CutPro transcreve qualquer áudio ou vídeo em legendas com tempo, em SRT, VTT, texto ou JSON, prontas para resumir ou traduzir.

O ChatGPT sempre mostra o preço e pergunta antes de gerar, iniciar um trabalho ou publicar qualquer coisa. Tudo acontece no seu próprio workspace do CutPro, o mesmo que você usa no cut.pro.

es-ES.subtitle: Imagen, video y clips con IA
es-ES.description:
Genera imágenes y videos con los mejores modelos de IA en un solo lugar: Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, Nano Banana, GPT Image y más. Describe lo que quieres, elige el modelo o deja que CutPro elija el mejor por su precio, y recibe el resultado en el propio ChatGPT. Anima una imagen que acabas de generar, pasa de un primer a un último fotograma, o usa una persona, un producto o un estilo de tus referencias.

Crea personas con IA: personas realistas que se mantienen iguales en cada foto y cada video, hechas a partir de rasgos o de personajes listos. Pon una persona en cualquier video en lugar de quien aparece en él, conservando la escena, la cámara, el movimiento y el sonido. Ideal para UGC, anuncios y canales sin rostro.

CutPro también encuentra los mejores momentos de un video largo y los convierte en clips verticales cortos, con subtítulos. Pega un enlace de YouTube, Twitch, Kick o TikTok y CutPro lo recorta, ordena los clips, aplica tus plantillas, renderiza los MP4 y los publica en las cuentas que conectaste en cut.pro, al momento o programados. Recorta directos mientras están al aire.

Programa publicaciones en TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, Threads, LinkedIn, Pinterest y Bluesky: cualquier clip, video generado o video de persona sale al momento o a la hora que elijas, y puedes moverla o cancelarla antes de que salga. ¿Falta una cuenta? ChatGPT te da el enlace para conectarla en cut.pro y sigue donde se quedó. Y CutPro transcribe cualquier audio o video en subtítulos con tiempos, en SRT, VTT, texto o JSON, listos para resumir o traducir.

ChatGPT siempre muestra el precio y pregunta antes de generar, iniciar un trabajo o publicar algo. Todo sucede en tu propio workspace de CutPro, el mismo que usas en cut.pro.
